scope: Read-only bounded screen of retained 528 lexical microbial PathBank leads; not exhaustive pathway absence or source exhaustion. All current 201 YAML IDs/labels inspected.

candidates.label: 3-phenylpropanoate and 3-(3-hydroxyphenyl)propanoate degradation
candidates.boundary: Both starting aromatic branches converge at 3-(2,3-dihydroxyphenyl)propanoate, then ring cleavage and hydrolysis yield succinate and a five-carbon dienol; complete terminal module yields pyruvate and acetyl-CoA. Eight native reactions, not a selected easy subset.
conflicts: Broad PathBank maps include separate cinnamate branches and unrelated acetolactate synthesis; selected exact native whole route is independently defined.
Legacy 2-oxopent-4-enoate tautomer versus current (2Z)-2-hydroxypenta-2,4-dienoate must be reconciled from original sources.
Net NADH dioxygenase reaction must not be double-counted with component ferredoxin reductase reaction.
MhpE/MhpF physical interaction must not be inflated to an unsupported fixed assembly.
candidates.novelty: No maintained record hit in both full hidden/ignored-inclusive identity and mechanism searches; prior matches are inventories and curation context, not an existing pathway.

candidates.label: adenine and adenosine salvage V
candidates.boundary: Adenine -> adenosine -> inosine -> IMP, using the Gsk inosine-kinase terminal branch.
primary: PMID:7665468 (full primary retrieval must be verified)
conflicts: PathBank calls this salvage II, but native MetaCyc PWY-6611 calls it V; current PWY-6605 salvage II is a different nucleosidase/APRT route.
Existing salvage I/III and guanine salvage share proteins and individual reactions, but none represents this exact native three-step adenine-to-IMP kinase route.
Gsk ligand/assembly and GTP-regulation source conflicts already documented in guanine dossier must remain explicit.
candidates.novelty: No maintained exact ID, label, or INOSINEKIN-RXN match in both scoped repositories; all prior PWY-6611 descriptions are explicit alternative-route assessments.

candidates.label: adenosine nucleotides degradation II
candidates.boundary: AMP -> adenosine -> inosine -> hypoxanthine -> xanthine -> urate.
conflicts: PathBank falsely combines UshA/PhoA/AphA into one physical phosphatase complex; assign only independently supported enzyme alternatives.

Current XdhABC annotation explicitly remains putative, and accepts dehydrogenase-versus-oxidase uncertainty. Primary genetics support purine interconversion and incomplete catabolism, not purified NAD-dependent full route or aerobic growth on purines.
Existing salvage III ends IMP; this complete degradation boundary ends urate and is distinct despite two shared central steps.
candidates.next_action: Inspect full PMID10986234 and exact native phosphatase assignments; retain inference grades and do not label the full graph experimentally reconstructed.

other_screen_dispositions.disposition: Not recommended as-is: original graph has D-serine -> L-serine dehydratase protein -> aminoacrylate side artifacts; native independent identity and DsdA assignment required.
